title: A STIM KEEPS ITS KEY WHEN THE PLATE TAKES KEY 9
why: Found by the review of the four-gun belt (build 3). With four gun keys, three throws and Medical, key 9 is the only empty key, and it is the plate key whenever he carries an Armour Plate. A Stim the game had put on key 9 lost its key the moment he picked a plate up (the automatic pin found no empty key to move to and was deleted), and a Stim found or paid at a revive while carrying a plate (the freebie kit always has one) got no key and no line. Before the four gun keys, keys 8 and 9 were both free, so neither happened. Such a Stim now goes on a vacant gun key 3 or 4 (any item may go on a gun key), and with none free it says NO FREE KEY. Gun keys a gun needs are never taken.
now: A Stim keeps a belt key when you carry an Armour Plate: it goes on a free gun key 3 or 4.
